description: The connected X account's STREAM SOURCES, the RTMP ingest points a live broadcast plays from. action 'list' (default) and 'get' (id) show each source's id (19 digits), RTMPS URL, region and whether video is arriving; 'stream_key' (id) reads its stream key, which X leaves out of the list; 'create' (name, optional region, the nearest one when omitted) makes one and returns its key; 'rename' (id, name); 'delete' (id, confirm:true: it kills the stream key); 'region' reads the nearest ingest region. Pass a source's id as sourceId to manage_x_broadcast. The stream key is a secret, so never post it. Needs X connected with the broadcast permissions added 2026-09-21: an X connection made before then must be reconnected once under Settings > Connectors > X (the tool says so without calling X). Costs credits (X bills per call).

account.description: which connected account: its @handle or id from list_connector_accounts; needed only when several are connected

confirm.description: true only after the user approved deleting this source

id.description: source id, for get, stream_key, rename and delete

region.description: create only: an ingest region such as us-east-1 or us-west-2; omitted = the nearest, from action 'region'

name: manage_x_stream_source
title: Manage X stream sources
